instructions.title: Instructions
instructions.welcomeTitle: Welcome to Your Weekly Time Diary. Thank you for participating!
instructions.studyIntroDefault:
This is our time use study.

We are asking you to reconstruct a typical week of your daily activities using our time use tool.

Which week should I choose? Please think of your past week (the last 7 days).
Exception: If you were sick or on holiday last week, please choose a different recent week that better represents your normal routine.
instructions.instructionsDefault:
#### How to fill out the diary

You will see a list of activities at the bottom of the screen. Click an activity to select it, then click on the timeline to place it, indicating what you were doing throughout the day.

- **Adjust duration:** Drag the left or right edge of a placed activity to set how long it lasted.
- **Delete an activity:** Right-click an activity on desktop, or long-press it on mobile, and choose "Delete".

Depending on the study, there may be more than one timeline for each day. These capture different aspects of your day or allow you to record activities you were doing in parallel.

**Time-Saving Feature:** You do not need to start from scratch every day. After you complete the first day, your schedule will automatically copy over to the next day as a template. Please adapt this template to reflect any changes in your activities for that day.
instructions.visualGuideTitle: Visual Illustrations of how to use the Interface
instructions.startPrompt: Please click the blue Start button to begin your diary entry.

step1.title: Select and Place an Activity
step1.horizontal: Choose an activity from the menu at the bottom of the screen, then place it on the timeline.
step1.vertical: Tap the (+) button in the bottom right corner to open the activity menu, then select an activity and tap where you want to place it on the timeline.

step2.title: Adjust Activity Duration
step2.horizontal: Click and drag the edges horizontally to set the duration. On desktop, you can also right-click an activity and choose "Show info" or "Delete".
step2.vertical: Drag the edges vertically to set the duration.

step3.title: Copy a Day
step3.horizontal: If another day looks similar, you can copy this day's activities: click "Copy this day" next to the day title and choose the day you want to copy it to. You can still adjust the copied entries afterwards.
step3.vertical: If another day looks similar, you can copy this day's activities: tap "Copy this day" next to the day title and choose the day you want to copy it to. You can still adjust the copied entries afterwards.

step4.title: Save and Submit Your Diary
step4.description: Once you have recorded your activities for a day, click the "Save Day" button to store them. You can still edit that day later. When all days of the study are complete, click the "Submit Study" button to send your diary and finish the study.
step4.saveHelp: Click to save the activities of the day you are working on
step4.submitStudyHelp: Click to submit your diary when every day is complete
